ceiling: Configuration validation only; declared policy does not prove running DNS discovery behavior, so it confirms service records, a TTL and the hardcoded-address flag are declared and never resolves a record.
offer: Publish service discovery records with a deliberate TTL and stable ownership. Hardcoding ephemeral addresses bypasses discovery and creates avoidable failover failures.

minimal.reason: List the service discovery records. Unlisted services cannot be found, so name each record.

mid.reason: Set the record TTL to at least 60 seconds. Very short TTLs load the resolver, so choose a deliberate value.

maximal.reason: Set hardcoding ephemeral addresses to false. Pinned addresses bypass discovery and break on failover, so use the record instead.
